  4. MRI → invasion ST: fascia propria, levator ani + sphincter → circumferatial resection magin is predictor of reccurance → evtl. neoadjucant chemo needed
  5. PET-CT → local + distant spread (esp. CT) + detection of recurrent rectal Ca (esp. PET)
  6. X-ray → lungs metsrigid sigmoidoscopy Mesorectal fascia = Fascia Propria

a. MRI is becoming the study of choice when evaluating complex fistulae

c. a fistulectomy removes the entire fibrotic tract by a step-by-step dissection of the tract

a:

fistulectomy:
removes entire fibrotic tract by dissection of tract from skin to proximal opening, injecting a dye through distal end can help to find the tract

fistulotomy:
canulation of fistula with probe, opening tract as wide as possible from one end to the other, part of the sphincter situated between fistula and mucosa is also divided
